summary: The filer, Western Copper & Gold Corp, a Canadian foreign private issuer, submitted a Form 6-K containing a Notice-and-Access Notification, Notice of Annual General and Special Meeting (June 12, 2026), Management Information Circular, and related proxy materials. The meeting agenda includes standard items: election of directors, appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor, and other routine business. No transaction terms, premiums, or structural events are disclosed. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing under the 1934 Act mapped to a US equivalent. What to watch: none; purely administrative compliance.
